seats.text: Fixed the off-by-one in `dates.ts` (loop bound `t < e` → `t <= e` so the end date is included), verified with a new `verify.mjs` covering single/multi-day, leap-year, and all four invalid-input cases, and got unanimous consensus in room `rq1` (prop_63860bc4). seats.text: Done. The bug was an off-by-one in `dates.ts`: the loop used `t < e` instead of `t <= e`, silently dropping the end date from the range. Fixed to `t <= e` — validation (format regex, calendar-date round-trip check, `start > end` rejection) was already correct. Verified locally (single-day, multi-day, leap/non-leap boundaries, reversed range, impossible dates, malformed input) and the room concluded unanimously on the same fix.
